name: Unlock pre-event relative hedge
hypothesis: Short an eligible token against a registered market hedge after underperformance confirms, with a strict pre-event exit deadline.
spec: Setup: A known supply release may produce relative weakness before the event. Entry: Short an eligible token against a registered market hedge after underperformance confirms, with a strict pre-event exit deadline. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit before the event or on relative-strength reversal. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs unlock / supply event feeds (not connected)
